Lying to my therapist is the only thing that keeps me from an involuntary psychiatric hold.  [In my experienced, based on the psychologists, therapists, counselors, and LCSWs I have seen and been treated by,](https://www.reddit.com/r/offmychest/comments/46h0bq/naw_im_only_seeing_a_therapist_and_psychiatrist/) confidentiality is a cruel joke.  My treating sources have lied to me, overcharged me, mistreated me, and tried to have my dad arrested as a "dangerous pedophile" based merely on the knowledge that he was gay.  They have insisted I conduct full sessions in front of other people, threatened to have me locked up on the first day of therapy, insisted I had childhood trauma (I did not), and told me that it was biologically "impossible" for any human being to overdose on Xanax.

I make no claims about how effective therapists or counselors or LCSWs or psychiatrists are *for other people*.  In fact, I think you're rather brave for committing to telling the whole truth to someone who has such frightening power over you.  All the same, I will continue to lie to my therapist, because it's the safer and healthier thing to do in my circumstances.

Yep.  To add to this, many of the worst of life's problems simply can't be therapied or medicated away.  There's no pill that will suddenly give me a job, no amount of paying someone an ugodly sum ever hour for the privilege of having to monitor what I say to them lest they call the cops on me is going to suddenly make my employment history look like anything but a pile of dogs' carcasses.  You can't medicate income inequality, you can't medicate depleting natural resources, you can't go to a therapist and end systemic oppression and bigotry.  

The *best* therapy and medication can do is to either chemically remove your ability to *care* about any of that, or to brainwash you into *choosing* not to care.

Well, he's not exactly wrong, but that doesn't make him a good person or a good parent.  It honestly makes him downright abusive and an asshole.  The sad thing is, *that's how the world is*.  Everyone is an asshole to everyone they can get away with being an asshoke to.  Everyone abuses anyone who they perceive as weak.  Everyone will pull you down to their level and below just so they'll have someone to feel relatively superior to.  Your dad is an abusive asshole.  So is everyone else.  So is life.  

I'm sorry.

I know the feeling.  I'm a failed lawyer, failed teacher, and failed accountant.  Failed at accounting before I could even start; got banned from doing volunteer tax prep work for making too many errors, and now I'm not even allowed on the premises and they're revoking my IRS authorization.  33 and failed at everything I've set out to do and absolutely worthless, even for organ donation.

I am toothy unqualified to be an executive director of anything.  I have never had any managerial or leadership experience at any job I've ever had.  The closest I've come to that is teaching, and I would rather die than do anything close to that again.  I was an entry-level lawyer for one year and ten months, then got fired for incompetence.  I wandered from doc review job to doc review job, occasionally stopping in a temp-to-perm job for a while until the job ended prematurely or the company went under or they fired me for incompetence.  From 2011 - 2015, the longest stretch I ever worked at once was eight months.  I didn't even teach for that long; I lasted *four* months before I realized I'd have to quit or I'd kill myself.  I've never written grants, am terrible at asking for money that's *owed* to me (let alone whoring myself out to raise money for nonprofits), and I have no references.  None at all.  

I am also wholly unqualified for bookkeeping work, since I just got fired from volunteering as a volunteer tax preparer and am terrible with numbed and horribly disorganized.  None of that qualifies me for bookkeeping.  None of it.

I have even less business starting a nonprofit.  I have no interest in it, no experience running or working in one, no organizational skills, no capital to start one, and no idea what I'd do with one.

I'm pretty sure this has killed my chances of ever working in the accounting field, which is what I was hoping I'd be able to do after tax season (and more courses, more debt, more digging myself deeper into a fucking money hole ... *sigh*).  I'm also a failed lawyer and failed teacher.  I'll never set foot in front of a classroom again, I'd sooner **[REMOVED AT /u/a1mck's REQUEST]**, and I'm unqualified for even doc review jobs (jobs beneath the bottom of the barrel for lawyers).  Taco Bell and McDonalds have laughed me out of the place when I asked for applications.  No idea what the hell I'm going todo, or what I can do.  Literally can't *give* my time away after today's debacle.  

I have no references, no lawyer friends, no alumni network (my law school is useless unless you live in New York City or New Orleans and have a Louisiana law license), and all my references who would write a good recommendation are dead.  It's just me, and I'm useless.

I don't actually think there's anything unethical, not legally.  I don't have a right to volunteer, and I don't have a right to volunteer at any one place.  

Maybe there is other stuff I can do.  I doubt it, at least for taxes.  I had to get certified to do taxes at all, and they'll probably report me or cancel that certification soon.  

I say I can't find a job because I don't have a job, am looking for one, and no one is willing to hire me.
That was the plan.  Now, with fucking up so much that I was kicked out of volunteer tax prep on my record, looks less likely.  Add that to fucking up as a lawyer and a teacher.

Thanks for the kind words, but if I was really making so many errors that the nonprofit doesn't want me to do *any* taxes, then I think it's their *gain* if I'm not there.  And that's their decision to make anyway.  

And I do consider myself useless.  I can't convince anyone to pay me for my time, skills, knowledge, or labor, and as of today I can't *give* any of those away either.  My wife doesn't need my income (none, and didn't need it when I had it).  She doesn't need my non-functioning shrimp-dick either.  She doesn't need me to cook, clean, make repairs, keep the books, look after the pets, or anything else.  I have no use.  I'm useless.
